title: Heptagon
summary: HEP'TAGON, noun [Gr. seven, and an angle.] In geometry, a figure consisting of seven sides and as many angles. In fortification, a place that has seven bastions for defense.

inlines.v: HEP'TAGON, noun [Gr. seven, and an angle.] In geometry, a figure consisting of seven sides and as many angles. In fortification, a place that has seven bastions for defense.
